messages:
samir: Heads-up: third-party pen test (vendor: RedProbe) booked for next Wed against staging. They request kms:Encrypt + kms:Decrypt on a single test key and an assume-role. Proposing a 2.5h corridor 11:00-13:30 PDT. Any blockers?

zoe: Sounds fine. We should restrict to one key + ephemeral role. Also require an IP allowlist for the vendor during the window.

harper: Agreed. Recommend TTL 1h on sessions, explicit denies for kms:PutKeyPolicy/kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion, and mark the key non-rotatable until the run completes. I can own issuance.

infra-bot: infra note: will add a tiny terraform change to create role + IP whitelist + read-only CloudTrail viewer role. Example assume-role CLI:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::777777:role/redprobe-pt --role-session-name redprobe --duration-seconds 3600
```
PR will be tagged "pt-access" for fast-track.

samir: Good. Ops, can we export CloudTrail to immutable S3 and confirm retention? We need the logs available for evidence packaging.

ops-bot: automated: scheduled CloudTrail export to s3://audit-archive/pt/2440223344 at 13:40 PDT (immutable retention 90d).

zoe: Evidence checklist for each finding: CloudTrail event ids (kms and sts), VPC flow logs for test hosts, app traces with trace ids, request/response pairs. Attach to one triage ticket per finding with label "redprobe-pt".

harper: Oncall paging: only page for Critical/High if active exploitation or service impact. Medium/low -> collect and triage after corridor.

samir: Alarm idea: set CloudWatch metric for >50 kms:Decrypt attempts/min from single principal -> post to #eng-security; page only if sustained >150/min. Avoid noisy PD.

infra-bot: also adding optional auto-throttle lambda in PR: if alarm fires, attach a deny kms:Decrypt policy to the test role for 10min cooldown. Marked optional.

zoe: RBAC rule: no broad policy edits during the window. Quick mitigations must be PR'd and fast-reviewed by samir + harper. No wildcard allow.

harper: Retest plan: vendor to re-run targeted findings within 4 business days after fix verification; reserve up to 2h per retest. Use the same key/role for parity.

samir: Action items recap:
- infra-bot/infra: terraform role + IP whitelist + optional auto-throttle lambda (PR by Mon EOD)
- ops-bot/ops: confirm CloudTrail export & immutability (confirm by Tue)
- harper: ephemeral issuance runbook + obs checklist (Tue)
- zoe: repro template & triage board labels (Tue)

infra-bot: bridge created: https://infra.company/bridges/redprobe-2440223344 (automated)

samir: If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll lock the corridor and fast-track the infra PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

zoe: LGTM.

harper: all good from me.
